items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: And I knew Brian Gilbert for a long time.

ctx.x: I don't believe it about Sidney Allen. Is he living in Sidney? No, but I'm the white as Sidney Allen. Well, I understand when he first wrote Lazy Ripper, he called it Lazy Lazy Nigger. That was the first thing we heard of him, huh?
And I knew Brian Gilbert for a long time. I didn't really know him. He was a young man. What about the one-armed trumpet player?
What was his name? Tweedy? Tweedy, yeah.
